info.title: CX Switches
info.description: API service to run troubleshooting tests on devices - Access Points (APs), CX Switches, AOS-S Switches, and Gateways (GWs).

tags.name: CX Switches
tags.description: Troubleshooting operations on CX Switches (The stackId should be used in place of the serial for stack switches)

post.summary: Initiate a Aaa test on a CX Switch
post.description: Starts an asynchronous Aaa test on the specified CX Switch.

202.description: Accepted. The operation has been successfully initiated. The response includes the location to track the operation's status.

full.summary: CX Switch Aaa request with additional parameters

get.summary: Get CX Switch Aaa test status and results
get.description: Retrieves the status and results of a previously initiated asynchronous CX Switch Aaa test.

200.description: OK. Returns the status and results of the CX Switch Aaa test.

get.summary: List active async tasks for a CX Switch
get.description: Retrieves a list of all active or recently completed asynchronous operations for the specified CX Switch, grouped by test name. Results are sorted by startTime in descending order (most recently started first).

200.description: OK. Returns the strict, supported list.

post.description: Starts an asynchronous execution of one or more 'show' commands on a CX switch. Rejected with 400 if any command does not start with 'show ', or if more than 20 commands are provided.

requestBody.description: The list of 'show' commands to run.

202.description: Accepted. Operation initiated; use the returned location to poll status/result.

get.description: Polls the async task for the 'show' commands and returns status and raw text output.
